title: Genres and what texts are for

steps.say: Fiction is made up. Non-fiction gives facts.
steps.show: fiction: fairy tale | non-fiction: guide to birds

steps.say: Fiction has genres. Fantasy has magic. Historical stories are set in the past. Dilemma stories have a hard choice.
Non-fiction texts have purposes. A recount tells what happened. An explanation tells how or why. An advert persuades.
Persuasive texts use strong words, exclamation marks and commands.
steps.show: The BEST waterpark! Come this weekend!

steps.say: A theme is the big idea. Different stories can share a theme such as kindness or honesty.

check.prompt: A book about a talking dragon is which kind of book?

options.why: Non-fiction gives true facts, and dragons do not talk.
It does not tell a reader how to do something.

check.explanation: A talking dragon is made up, so the book is fiction.

check.prompt: What is the main purpose of an advert?

options.text: to persuade you to buy or do something

options.why: That is the job of fiction.
That is the job of instructions.
That is the job of a diary entry.

hints: Think of a poster for a shop.
What does it want you to do?
check.explanation: An advert tries to persuade readers to buy something or visit a place.
